responsibility: This module is the GCC target backend for Texas Instruments C6X DSP processors, covering the machine-dependent code-generation, ABI, and target-environment support needed to lower GCC’s generic representations into C6X assembly. Its core implementation and specification files define target hooks, register and data-layout rules, calling conventions, address legality, section selection, builtin and intrinsic support, and assembly/unwind emission, while the main machine-description files, predicates, and constraints describe how RTL operations map onto C6X instructions, including DSP/vector modes, multiply and packed-arithmetic families, synchronization sequences, and operand classes. A major distinguishing responsibility of this port is its detailed exposed-pipeline and modulo-scheduling support for the C6X functional units, modeled through generated scheduling descriptions and multiply-pattern variants. The module also includes target option machinery for ISA selection and small-data/DSBT/endianness controls, plus ELF and uClinux configuration headers that adapt the backend to the relevant binary and runtime environments.
